runners_data.note: Front-runner returning after 100-day break with known finishing problems that could set this up for others.

races.paceDynamic: Destination Unkown, Ade Boy and Tread Carefully will drive this race from the front, creating a strong gallop that will severely test stamina over this demanding 2m4½f trip. With three confirmed leaders in a small field, the pace will be genuine throughout with little respite. The early tempo will be honest, building pressure from halfway as the front-runners battle for supremacy. This sustained gallop strongly favours hold-up horses who can stay off the pace and finish with a late charge when the pace-setters weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners duel and set an unsustainable gallop
scenarios.body: The strong early pace will find out the leaders' stamina limitations, allowing the patient hold-up performers to sweep past in the final furlong when others tire. Emerald Breeze and Pertemps are perfectly positioned to exploit this likely scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One Leader Survives Duel
scenarios.trigger: If Ade Boy or Tread Carefully can break clear of the early pace battle
scenarios.body: The survivor will have enough left to resist late challenges, particularly if they can dictate terms and steady the gallop mid-race. Ade Boy's recent course win gives him the edge in this tactical battle.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Destination Unkown's known finishing issues force a steadier tempo early
scenarios.body: Without the expected fierce gallop, prominent runners can position closer and the race becomes more tactical than stamina-based. This suits horses who can travel well but may struggle in a true test.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If all three leaders go too fast too early and stop dramatically
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish between whatever horses remain with energy, potentially favouring the lowest-rated runner who has been under less pressure. This unlikely scenario opens the door for a surprise.

watchPoints.text: Destination Unkown may fade badly in the finish as historically - if he leads too long the pace could become stop-start
Tread Carefully's jumping under pressure when the pace intensifies - any mistakes will end his chances quickly
How aggressively the three front-runners engage early - the more they battle, the better for hold-up horses
Emerald Breeze's inexperienced jockey navigating traffic problems if the pace collapses and creates a bunch finish
Whether Ade Boy can settle better than his recent front-running suggests and keep something in reserve

races.paceDynamic: De Deli Counter and Perfect Arch will dispute the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners likely to go a decent clip from the start. The honest gallop will stretch the field out over this 2m4½f trip, creating gaps for the large contingent of hold-up horses including Gms Prince, Lillistar, and Times A Wastin. With most of the field preferring to come from behind, the early pace will be crucial in determining whether the leaders can stay or the closers can bridge the gap. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace without getting involved in the early battle, as they can avoid both the pressure up front and the traffic problems that may hinder the back-markers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained pace favours trackers
scenarios.trigger: If De Deli Counter and Perfect Arch maintain a solid gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The honest pace will find out the stamina of both leaders and create the perfect setup for horses positioned prominently to strike. By The Grace and Lemon Leaf can track the pace and have the class to capitalize when the front two weaken.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leaders dominate weak field
scenarios.trigger: If the pace-setters get an easy lead and the opposition fails to mount a serious challenge
scenarios.body: De Deli Counter's recent better form and Perfect Arch's front-running ability could see them dictate terms and hold on. The lack of serious early pace pressure allows them to control the race completely.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late surge from hold-up horses
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is too strong and burns out the leaders completely
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will set up perfectly for the patient hold-up horses to unleash late runs. Gms Prince has course form and Lillistar showed good form before his break, both suited by a truly-run race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapse benefits closer
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast early and fade dramatically in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The race will become a sprint finish where the freshest horse wins, suiting those held up furthest off the pace. This would particularly benefit any horse with a turn of foot who has been kept out of trouble.

watchPoints.text: Perfect Arch and De Deli Counter could go too fast early and set up the race for the hold-up horses behind them
Lillistar returning after 72 days off needs to be monitored for fitness on his seasonal return
By The Grace representing in-form Nicky Henderson yard should be watched for market confidence
The large contingent of hold-up horses could create traffic problems in the straight if bunched together
Going remains good across all Market Rasen races today, confirming consistent conditions throughout the card

races.paceDynamic: Achille Des Rocs will set the early fractions from the front with Ballynaheer and Rodney Bay likely to track closely behind in the small field. scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Achille Des Rocs maintains steady fractions without collapse
scenarios.body: Ballynaheer and Achille Des Rocs can utilize their tactical speed from forward positions while Dangerous Touch gets stranded too far back. The even gallop plays to horses that can stay handy and quicken late rather than rely on a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders go too fast and tire dramatically
scenarios.body: Dangerous Touch's hold-up style becomes the winning tactic as the front-runners weaken significantly in the final furlong. His superior recent RPR ratings and finishing kick prove decisive when others stop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Rodney Bay Springs Surprise

scenarios.body: The light weight of 156lbs helps Rodney Bay stay competitive longer than usual before his customary late fade. Harry Reed times his run perfectly to exploit a moderate pace scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Achille Des Rocs Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the long layoff hasn't dulled his fitness and he gets uncontested lead
scenarios.body: The 348-day absence proves irrelevant as Achille Des Rocs utilizes his class advantage to control from the front. McMenamin judges the pace perfectly to resist all challengers.

watchPoints.text: Achille Des Rocs may need the run badly after 348 days absence and could weaken dramatically if not fully tuned up.
Dangerous Touch must be held up but risks being left with too much to do in a small field with limited pace.
Ballynaheer's excellent going record on similar conditions makes him the most reliable tactical option.
Rodney Bay typically fades in the final furlong so watch for any signs of his usual late weakening pattern.
The small field means less cover and fewer pace angles, putting premium on tactical positioning from the start.

races.paceDynamic: Gower Prince is the sole confirmed front runner and will set the early tempo without pressure from rivals. Beat The Edge and Forsa Bay are the only prominent runners, but both can also sit off the pace if needed. The majority field of hold-up horses (Starman, It's Party Time, Lone Soldier, Kally Des Bruyeres, Cawthorne Cracker) will create a bunched pack behind the leader. This uncontested lead scenario strongly favours either the front runner getting an easy time of it, or the proven closers who can time their challenge perfectly off a steady gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Gower Prince gets an easy lead and jumps cleanly throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows him to dictate fractions and save energy for the finish. His proven front-running style becomes a major tactical advantage when unopposed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate early pace sets up perfectly for a hold-up horse with finishing speed
scenarios.body: The steady gallop allows the best finisher to get into perfect position and unleash a decisive late challenge. Quality hold-up performers thrive when they can time their run off controlled fractions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If Beat The Edge or Forsa Bay can track the leader and strike approaching the last
scenarios.body: The tactical advantage of sitting second allows them to monitor Gower Prince while staying clear of traffic behind. They can exploit any weakening of the leader while avoiding the pack.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Gower Prince stops suddenly and the field comes to the boil very late
scenarios.body: A messy finish develops where positioning becomes crucial and the handiest horse on the day prevails. This scenario typically produces surprise winners from midfield.

races.paceDynamic: Hijo De La Luna provides the only confirmed early pace with his prominent style, supported by Ruler Legend and Cawthorne Banker in the vanguard. With six hold-up horses in the field, the early gallop will be sustainable rather than breakneck, allowing the leaders to dictate terms without serious pressure. The lack of genuine speed merchants means the pace will build gradually, creating a tactical affair where positioning matters more than pure speed. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the modest early pace and hold-up horses with a strong finishing kick over those needing a truly-run race.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Benefits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Hijo De La Luna and the prominent runners maintain a steady rhythm without being challenged early
scenarios.body: The measured pace allows the front division to conserve energy while the hold-up horses face a positioning nightmare in a small field. Prominent runners like Cawthorne Banker can kick clear before the closers get organized.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes overly pedestrian and the field bunches up approaching the final circuit
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine speed creates a sprint finish where class and finishing kick matter most, suiting the better-rated hold-up performers. Kalkaroo and Diesel Line can unleash their superior finishing speed when it counts.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Hijo De La Luna gets an uncontested lead and the field allows him comfortable sectionals throughout
scenarios.body: The son of Shirocco can dictate every fraction and use his stamina to grind out victory, with the hold-up horses left with too much to do. His recent Stratford victory suggests he thrives when allowed to lead.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both prominent runners Hijo De La Luna and Ruler Legend disappoint or make errors, leaving no early pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical crawl that turns into a cavalry charge, creating chaos that can benefit any horse with tactical speed regardless of rating. The 148lb minimum weighted horses get a significant advantage.
